Week of June 28

Filed under: #weekly | Sun Jul 05 2026

Hi. Another week, another week in review!

My goals for last week: have fun and work on my UTAU. Well, that is exactly what I've been doing. I'm almost done with otoing the VCV, I just need to correct a few more issues… but Art Fight started recently, and I got distracted so I've been drawing instead of fixing those issues. Hey, that's fine, right!?

It's sort of my first year participating. I joined last year*, but only for attacking because I didn't have original characters at the time. And I only drew like, two attacks. This year is different, though — I have a total of one OC, my UTAU!

To be honest, that's about it. I worked on my UTAU and then a few days into Art Fight I started killing my hand so I could draw other people's UTAU voicebanks.

I went out with my friends on Wednesday, but I was thinking about my UTAU the whole time.

It's been a pretty good week. I want to continue this. Continue drawing and working on my UTAU — this week's goals. I want to attack as many people as I can. But my hand is experiencing severe cramps already so maybe it won't be too many.

That's all that I have. See you next week.

*I joined Art Fight in like 2020 but I deleted my account and made a new one this year.
